title: Equivalence of full satisfaction formulations
statement: Let $G$ be a finite unique game and let $\ell$ assign one of the $q$ labels to each vertex. Then every game constraint is satisfied by $\ell$ if and only if $\ell$ satisfies every constraint in the associated constraint satisfaction instance.
